notes: `הַשְׁכֵּם` is headed on *rising* as the lexical verb; the competing reading heads it on *early*, which is what distinguishes the lexeme from plain rising.
`בְּיַד` is fused under rule 30 and headed on `יָד` per rule 23.
The second `עַל` licenses the second written *on*; the coordinated phrase is not a distributed repetition of the first preposition.
